description: This file defines a custom exception class 'MultiDisbursementDataNotAllowedException' within the Fineract platform, specifically related to loan account disbursement rules. The class extends 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException' and is used to signal that multiple disbursement data is not allowed for a specific entity.

classes.name: MultiDisbursementDataNotAllowedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that multiple disbursement data is not permitted for a specific entity in the loan account process.

methods.name: MultiDisbursementDataNotAllowedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with entity-specific message keys and parameters.
